continuous_imputation: Development-fitted IterativeImputer, median initialization, max_iter=25, random_state=20269806.
preprocessing: Per-component fitted StandardScaler, RBF SVC and sigmoid calibration.
laboratory_timing: CK, LDH and neutrophil percentage recorded in the preoperative laboratory section; exact sampling times unavailable.
operative_time: Recorded surgery start to end, minutes; not anesthesia duration.
cryoprecipitate: Total mL; study-specific historical conversion 25 mL/U, not universal.
calculator_missing_data: Complete inputs required; no interface imputation. Defaults illustrative.
use: Research only; preliminary external validation, not a clinical action or diagnostic tool.
threshold_origin: Original development Youden threshold retained unchanged.
endpoint: Recorded peak cTnI >=70 times study URL on postoperative days 1-3; biomarker-defined PMI.
